# Local catalog and audit helpers
Python 3.9+ standard library only. No network, databases, UI or third-party dependencies.

Code modules: `catalog` owns product queries and existing receipt formatting; `audit` owns audit summaries. Neither calls the other. `shared` holds the existing receipt formatter used by catalog.
Public legacy functions must keep their behaviour.

Run all tests from the repository root with `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. Tests may be added for a change.

import copy
import unittest
from src.audit.summary import event_snapshot

def event(id="e1", kind="login", timestamp="2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", **extra):
    value = {"id": id, "kind": kind, "timestamp": timestamp}
    value.update(extra)
    return value

class EventSnapshotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    # TEST-E1
    def test_shape_order_and_counts(self):
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot([]), {"counts": {}, "accepted_ids": [], "errors": []})
        result = event_snapshot([event("b", "Login"), event("a", "login"), event("c", "Login", extra=1)])
        self.assertEqual(result, {"counts": {"Login": 2, "login": 1}, "accepted_ids": ["b", "a", "c"], "errors": []})

    # TEST-E2
    def test_field_reasons_in_order(self):
        cases = [
            (event(id=""), "invalid_id"), (event(id=7), "invalid_id"), ({"kind": "k", "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}, "invalid_id"),
            (event(kind=""), "invalid_kind"), (event(kind=None), "invalid_kind"), ({"id": "x", "timestamp": "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"}, "invalid_kind"),
            ({"id": "x", "kind": "k"}, "invalid_timestamp"),
            ({"id": "", "kind": "", "timestamp": "bad"}, "invalid_id"), ({"id": "x", "kind": "", "timestamp": "bad"}, "invalid_kind"),
        ]
        for value, reason in cases:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                self.assertEqual(event_snapshot([value])["errors"], [{"index": 0, "reason": reason}])
        result = event_snapshot([event(id=" ", kind=" ")])
        self.assertEqual(result["accepted_ids"], [" "])
        self.assertEqual(result["counts"], {" ": 1})

    # TEST-E3
    def test_timestamp_format_and_calendar(self):
        bad = ["2024-01-01T00:00:00", "2024-01-01T00:00:00z", "2024-01-01 00:00:00Z", "2024-01-01T00:00:00.0Z",
               "2024-01-01T00:00:00+00:00", " 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z\n", "２０２４-01-01T00:00:00Z",
               "2024-1-01T00:00:00Z", "2023-02-29T00:00:00Z", "2024-13-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-04-31T00:00:00Z",
               "2024-01-01T24:00:00Z", "2024-01-01T00:60:00Z", "2024-01-01T23:59:60Z", "0000-01-01T00:00:00Z", 20240101, None]
        for value in bad:
            with self.subTest(timestamp=value):
                self.assertEqual(event_snapshot([event(timestamp=value)])["errors"], [{"index": 0, "reason": "invalid_timestamp"}])
        for value in ["2024-02-29T00:00:00Z", "0001-01-01T00:00:00Z", "9999-12-31T23:59:59Z"]:
            with self.subTest(timestamp=value):
                self.assertEqual(event_snapshot([event(timestamp=value)])["accepted_ids"], ["e1"])

    # TEST-E4
    def test_inclusive_window_skips_outside_without_error(self):
        events = [event("a", timestamp="2024-01-01T00:00:00Z"), event("b", timestamp="2024-01-02T00:00:00Z"),
                  event("c", timestamp="2024-01-03T00:00:00Z"), event("d", timestamp="2023-12-31T23:59:59Z"),
                  event("e", timestamp="2024-01-03T00:00:01Z")]
        result = event_snapshot(events, "2024-01-01T00:00:00Z", "2024-01-03T00:00:00Z")
        self.assertEqual(result, {"counts": {"login": 3}, "accepted_ids": ["a", "b", "c"], "errors": []})
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot(events, start="2024-01-02T00:00:00Z")["accepted_ids"], ["b", "c", "e"])
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot(events, end="2024-01-01T00:00:00Z")["accepted_ids"], ["a", "d"])
        self.assertEqual(event_snapshot(events)["accepted_ids"], ["a", "b", "c", "d", "e"])

    # TEST-E5
    def test_dedupe_after_validation_and_window(self):
        events = [
            event("x", timestamp="bad"),
            event("x", "early", timestamp="2023-01-01T00:00:00Z"),
            event("x", "first"),
            event("x", "second"),
            event("y", "first"),
            event("y", "first", timestamp="bad"),
        ]
        result = event_snapshot(events, start="2024-01-01T00:00:00Z")
        self.assertEqual(result, {"counts": {"first": 2}, "accepted_ids": ["x", "y"],
                                  "errors": [{"index": 0, "reason": "invalid_timestamp"}, {"index": 5, "reason": "invalid_timestamp"}]})

    # TEST-E6
    def test_does_not_mutate_and_is_repeatable(self):
        events = [event("a"), event("a", "other"), event("b", timestamp="bad")]
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(events)
        first = event_snapshot(events)
        first["counts"]["login"] = 99
        first["accepted_ids"].append("z")
        second = event_snapshot(events)
        self.assertEqual(events, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(second, {"counts": {"login": 1}, "accepted_ids": ["a"], "errors": [{"index": 2, "reason": "invalid_timestamp"}]})

import copy
import decimal
import unittest
from src.catalog.query import product_snapshot, receipt_for

def item(**overrides):
    base = {"id": "p1", "name": "Widget", "active": True, "category": "tools", "price": "1.50"}
    base.update(overrides)
    return base

class ProductSnapshotTests(unittest.TestCase):
    # TEST-P1
    def test_returns_products_and_errors_only(self):
        self.assertEqual(product_snapshot([]), {"products": [], "errors": []})
        self.assertEqual(set(product_snapshot([item()])), {"products", "errors"})

    # TEST-P2
    def test_keeps_input_order_and_duplicates(self):
        result = product_snapshot([item(id="b"), item(id="a"), item(id="b")])
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in result["products"]], ["b", "a", "b"])

    # TEST-P3
    def test_field_reasons_in_order(self):
        cases = [
            (item(id=""), "invalid_id"), (item(id=5), "invalid_id"),
            ({"name": "n", "active": True, "category": "c", "price": "1"}, "invalid_id"),
            (item(name=None), "invalid_name"), ({"id": "x", "active": True, "category": "c", "price": "1"}, "invalid_name"),
            (item(active=1), "invalid_active"), (item(active=0), "invalid_active"), (item(active="true"), "invalid_active"),
            ({"id": "x", "name": "n", "category": "c", "price": "1"}, "invalid_active"),
            (item(category=None), "invalid_category"), ({"id": "x", "name": "n", "active": True, "price": "1"}, "invalid_category"),
            ({"id": "x", "name": "n", "active": True, "category": "c"}, "invalid_price"),
        ]
        for value, reason in cases:
            with self.subTest(value=value):
                self.assertEqual(product_snapshot([value])["errors"], [{"index": 0, "reason": reason}])

    # TEST-P4
    def test_only_first_error_and_untrimmed_id(self):
        result = product_snapshot([{"id": "", "name": 1, "active": 1, "category": 1, "price": "x"}, item(id=" ", name="", category="", extra=1)])
        self.assertEqual(result["errors"], [{"index": 0, "reason": "invalid_id"}])
        self.assertEqual(result["products"], [{"id": " ", "label": "", "price": "1.50"}])
        result = product_snapshot([item(name=3, active=2)])
        self.assertEqual(result["errors"], [{"index": 0, "reason": "invalid_name"}])

    # TEST-P5
    def test_price_format(self):
        for price in ["-1", "+1", " 1", "1 ", "1e2", "1.", ".5", "1.234", "１", "٣", "1,00", "", "1\n", 1, 1.5, None]:
            with self.subTest(price=price):
                self.assertEqual(product_snapshot([item(price=price)])["errors"], [{"index": 0, "reason": "invalid_price"}])
        for price, shown in [("0", "0.00"), ("001.2", "1.20"), ("10.05", "10.05"), ("000", "0.00"), ("12345678901234567890.9", "12345678901234567890.90")]:
            with self.subTest(price=price):
                self.assertEqual(product_snapshot([item(price=price)])["products"][0]["price"], shown)

    # TEST-P6
    def test_decimal_context_unchanged(self):
        with decimal.localcontext() as ctx:
            ctx.prec = 3
            ctx.rounding = decimal.ROUND_DOWN
            ctx.traps[decimal.Inexact] = True
            before = (ctx.prec, ctx.rounding, dict(ctx.traps), dict(ctx.flags))
            product_snapshot([item(price="12345.67"), item(price="1e5")])
            current = decimal.getcontext()
            self.assertEqual((current.prec, current.rounding, dict(current.traps), dict(current.flags)), before)

    # TEST-P7
    def test_validate_before_filter(self):
        items = [
            item(id="a", category="tools"),
            item(id="b", active=False),
            item(id="c", category="Tools"),
            item(id="d", category="toys", price="bad"),
            item(id="e", active=False, price="bad"),
            item(id="f", category="toys"),
        ]
        result = product_snapshot(items, category="tools")
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in result["products"]], ["a"])
        self.assertEqual(result["errors"], [{"index": 3, "reason": "invalid_price"}, {"index": 4, "reason": "invalid_price"}])
        self.assertEqual([p["id"] for p in product_snapshot(items)["products"]], ["a", "c", "f"])
        self.assertEqual(product_snapshot([item(category="")], category="")["products"][0]["id"], "p1")

    # TEST-P8
    def test_output_shape_and_example(self):
        result = product_snapshot([item(id="k", name="ABCDEFGHIJK", price="001.2", extra="ignored")])
        self.assertEqual(result["products"], [{"id": "k", "label": "ABCDEFGH", "price": "1.20"}])
        self.assertEqual(product_snapshot([item(name="", price="0")])["products"], [{"id": "p1", "label": "", "price": "0.00"}])
        self.assertEqual(product_snapshot([item(name="😀é漢字abcdefg")])["products"][0]["label"], "😀é漢字abcd")

    # TEST-P9
    def test_does_not_mutate_and_is_repeatable(self):
        items = [item(id="a"), item(id="b", price="x"), item(active=False)]
        snapshot = copy.deepcopy(items)
        first = product_snapshot(items)
        first["products"].append("tamper")
        first["errors"].clear()
        second = product_snapshot(items)
        self.assertEqual(items, snapshot)
        self.assertEqual(second, product_snapshot(copy.deepcopy(snapshot)))
        self.assertEqual(len(second["products"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(second["errors"]), 1)

    # TEST-L1
    def test_label_length_does_not_change_receipt(self):
        product_snapshot([item(name="123456789012XYZ")])
        self.assertEqual(receipt_for("123456789012XYZ"), "receipt:123456789012")
        from src.shared.formatting import RECEIPT_LENGTH
        self.assertEqual(RECEIPT_LENGTH, 12)
